sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: ONNX Model Support for Geospatial Inference - GeoAI
sources.snippet: This notebook demonstrates how to use ONNX Runtime with GeoAI for efficient geospatial model inference. The ONNX module mirrors the AutoGeoModel API, allowing you to export Hugging Face models to ONNX format and run inference on GeoTIFF data using ONNX Runtime.
